verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an API platform like Stripe Connect, so the axis applies. The pack shows markdown docs, an llms.txt file, an MCP server and a CLI, but nothing about an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. The CLI and markdown docs are adjacent tooling, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
